nom: Good Molecules Yuzu Blemish Gel Cream

avis.texte: i got this because i get break outs fairly often, i was in the middle of one, bought this, and within two days, the large blemishes cleared up so fast. i was looking for this product mainly because i needed something with salicylic acid in it. it has an appropriate amount that doesnt irritate my EXTREMELY sensitive skin. a little goes A LONG WAY with this product too! additionally, the natural scent from the yuzu in the cream is so satisfying and not too strong.

Ive used this acne gel & the other good molecures acne gel. When I use this combined with the good molecules retinol cream its amazing! Itll clear up any black heads & junk in my nose / face overnight. I find that it works the best when combined with the retinol. Ive tried the other gel, but find it works better for spot treatment with new pimples. I suggest combining this yuzu gel with their retinol to see the best effects. if youre looking for overall skin improvement with pores / acne this & their retinol works wonder. If youre just looking for a spot treatment with new pimples, you can use this or their other gel cream in the blue bottle.

avis.titre: I would definitely repurchase this item a lot
avis.texte: This actually has really helped me with my acne, mine is just regular not cystic so I'm not sure how it would help with that type of acne but it has really evened and smoothed my skin along with making my acne a lot less that it originally was!
This has not helped at all. I actually think it's made my breakouts worse.

avis.titre: BRING BACK THE BHA CLARIFY GEL
avis.texte: The original is the only thing that worked for my breakouts. The new one makes them worse and causes new breakouts. May be allergic to something in this one, I dont know just please bring the old one back I'm almost out.

clears pimples right up! its just the right anount of SA to not irrotate my sensotive skin. just make aure you use a good moisturizer so it doesnt break your skin barrier and cause irritation. a little product goes a long way

Having very sensative skin, I use this on the areas where I have hormonal acne and it works so well! I was nervous about switching to this product from the previous acne cream I was using because it worked but this one works even better and its great for nightly use! I made the switch for the love of the brand and Good Molecules did not fail me, I love this brand and always will!!!
really great product, clears skin and is good for sensitive skin BUT use it as a spot treatment only!! it will burn your skin really bad if you use it all over

I have has no luck finding products that didnt burn my skin before trying this brand. First day using this my redness and bumps on my face went away. Second day they were complely gone! My skin looks great and its even helped get rid of my stubborn white heads

i've struggled with hormonal acne around my chin/cheeks for a few months now, and after a cycle of using this every morning i haven't seen any and my skin is clearer than it has been in years! it's definitely a bit drying/tight, but good :)

I wish you could delete old reviews. I was wrong, I stuck with it, and my skin has never been so clear. But this product isn't a traditional blemish cream. It won't get rid of anything overnight and may cause your skin to purge. However, if you stick with it, I promise you'll have glass skin.
I have very oily, acne prone skin and this gel cream works wonders on it. Love the consistency, the effectiveness, scent and the gel formula. I just wish it came in a bigger size!
This is my 2nd repurchase of the cream. Overall it seems like a good product but I would need to use it for a few more weeks to see any major results.

avis.titre: Clearer Skin in a Light, Fresh Gel!
avis.texte: I tried the Good Molecules Yuzu Blemish Gel Cream to help with my breakouts and uneven skin tone, and it really impressed me. The gel feels cool and light on my skin, sinking in fast without any stickiness. After a week, my small pimples started to fade, and my skin looked calmer and smoother. It's perfect for oily or combination skin that needs gentle care without heavy moisture.

Sometimes, I saw a big difference in my skin when I would apply it the night before, while other times it was less noticeable. It didn't make my skin oily, and I loved the slightly lemon smell. Overall, I would recommend!

avis.titre: Broke me out- Bring back the BHA Clarify Gel Cream
avis.texte: The only change in my routine was that it broke me out like crazy. Happened like overnight each time. I really tried to give it a chance, like maybe my skin was purging, but sometimes it's just a bad formula. Bring back the original formula. I love good molecules, but they frequently fix what isn't broken and always make it 10x worse.
I like this product. It doesn't have a super strong smell and doesn't have a sticky residue feeling.
Overall I love this product! It is gentle on my skin and doesn't dry me out like most blemish treatments. I do feel like this product has cleared those stubborn under the skin breakouts.

avis.titre: My ride or die in my skincare routine!!
avis.texte: The Yuzu Blemish Gel Cream has quickly become one of my go-to moisturizers. It's lightweight yet hydrating, so it keeps my skin balanced without feeling greasy. I love that it targets breakouts and helps calm redness while still being gentle enough for daily use. The subtle yuzu scent adds a refreshing touch, and over time I've noticed fewer blemishes and a more even complexion. Perfect for anyone looking for a soothing, breakout-friendly moisturizer.

I just started using this product, but it is amazing. My breakouts are always bad and they show very easily on my face. They are always red, puffy, or just large. This cream has helped the appearance of my breakouts insanely and has made me less insecure to not wear makeup on top of them!
This product has helped my skin so so much. I have always struggled with my acne and this product definitely makes a difference!

avis.titre: Only thing that has helped my closed comedones
avis.texte: This has completely changed my textured skin. I struggle with closed comedones and this has helped so much. I have tried so many things and this is the best.

avis.titre: Only acne cream that has worked for me!
avis.texte: I really struggled with closed comedones and this cream has helped so much. My skin is so much less textured and I feel like it helps the oily areas stay less oily. Highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: I think this does it's jo
avis.texte: I think this does it's job. It's not too stripping on its own and I can layer a moisturizer on comfortably
Its been good just consistently use it and follow instructions

I really love this cream! I'm doing retinol every other day & this on the off days & in the am. It sits beautifully on my face & I'm not getting the sting I've gotten from the retinol prior to using this.
I struggle with acne very frequently but this product helps minimize how frequent they pop up! If have any that pop up randomly, it also helps rid of them very fast!

Pimple patches are great but I was loing for another alternative. I don't regularly use salicylic acid in my routine because it can be drying, but this is perfect. You can spot treat or use all over the face. I get breakouts here and there and I do not have chronic acne so I cant offer an opinion for those people that do. I will say for the price I think its worth a try. Purchaed my second tube!
Helps lighten my acne marks. Its not instant but helps fades them faster. Partner it with the toner and niacinamide syrum

avis.titre: Does it's job and smells good
avis.texte: Lovely gel cream that goes on light and smooth. It focuses more on getting rid of blemishes than moisturizing, so you might need to moisturize on top of it. It has a gentle lemony sent from the yuzu

I used this and thought all was fine till i noticed the my skin texture started getting weird and super bumpy then i started breaking out with bad pimples and i used it again and my skin was burning and itching and i had to wash it off and now my face is super red from it so dont use it
Easy to use stuff. Takes very little to cover your whole face. Doesn't over dry.

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL FOR ACNE PRONE SKIN
avis.texte: It's a must for anyone with acne prone skin or heat bump related blemishes. Salicylic acid does the job Everytime.

avis.titre: not much difference from the original bha gel
avis.texte: I had been using the original version of this gel for many years. I don't see much change in my skin from using this new formula. It still keeps my skin clear, which is great, but there doesn't seem to be any added benefit that I have noticed.
Amazing! Big fan of this product- I don't get big pimples, just a lot of black heads/texture in my T-zone. This helps with that so much!

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for
avis.texte: I had small bumps like on my forehead and all over that have been there for months and this made it way better. I can tell in a week they'll be gone. Also the serums are very helpful as well
I loved it, no scent and it definitely helped with the acne appearing on my skin

So far this product has helped me with minor breakouts. It helps calm any irritated or inflamed acne. I think it's also helped my pimples go away faster. I haven't had any major breakouts to try it on yet so I didn't give it 5 stars. But so far so good. Also, I think you get a good amount of product. It's very thin and a little goes a long way. Worth every penny.
keeps my skin clear, use it overnight and wake up with glowing, even skin. Also helps with little bumps on my forehead.

I think the concept of this product is great and I like that the scent isn't overpowering!! However I'm saddened because it was not for my skin type. It actually made me breakout. It's ok I'm happy I can continue to use most of their products.

I have sensitive/acne prone skin so typically nee products tend to break me out, but this has not! Im on my second tube and love it - use it morning and night, extra moisturizer on top when needed, overall it has sinplified my routine and my skin is clearing up. Wish i could buy it in a bigger size!

avis.titre: Doesn't hold up to the original
avis.texte: The BHA Clarifying Gel Cream was a holy grail product for me and to say I was apprehensive about this formula change is an understatement. I went in with high hopes but this product hasn't been effective in any way. The BHA cream kept my t-zone from getting oily throughout the day, unfortunately I cannot say the same for this yuzu formula as my glasses are sliding down the oily bridge of my nose as I type this. It also causes my setting powder to settle into my pores emphasizing each one in a way that is equally amazing and horrifying. As for clearing blemishes, it seems to be completely uneffective. The BHA cream would clear up my stubborn pms breakouts in a few days, I'm going on two weeks of daily use trying to clear my face. Needless to say I won't be repurchasing this produc and have already started hunting for an alternative to my beloved BHA gel cream.

this is a really good affordable moisturizer for people with oily skin. it feels good on the skin, smells good, and is lightweight. this did not make me oily throughout the day. unfortunately, it gave me big zits on my face :( every time i used it it gave me a big zit. i tried to make it work but it truly gave me a zit every time. i have really sensitive skin so maybe the yuzu was too much!

This gel cream has changed my life. Honestly. It has kept my hormonal acne at bay like no other product I've tried. Not only is it reasonably priced, it has amazing ingredients and applying it is a dream. I'm so impressed with this company ❤️

I know everyone's skin is different, but this really works for my middle age hormonal breakouts (even when a lot of the more publicized treatments didn't). I've spent much more for ineffective products, so thankful to have found this cream!
